name: read_generated_plugin
description: Load one previously-generated plugin's files (profile, Python backend, tests, README) back into context, using the 'location' a list_generated_plugins call returned. Call this before discussing or modifying an existing plugin so the conversation is grounded in what's actually there, not guessed. This only reads the files -- it does not change anything; proposing and writing an update is a separate step the customer must still confirm.

location.description: The 'location' value from a list_generated_plugins result, identifying which generated plugin to load.
